topNews.text: Do-Good Doggies Fight Invasive Mussels on Team ‘Conservation Canines’
topNews.excerpt: Invasive species of Asian mussels have met their match in Alberta’s riverine sniffer dogs. These K9 conservationists have been employed by the provincial government for over a decade to help catch zebra and golden mussels from colonizing the rivers and lakes of Alberta. topNews.text: Used for Centuries as Poison, Larkspur, Wolfsbane May Become Medicine After Lab Breakthrough
topNews.excerpt: Two famously toxic plants—known also to treat pain, malaria, cancer, and pests—may have had those medicinal properties synthesized in a lab for the first time. topNews.text: UN Summit on HIV/AIDS Shows Incredible Progress in Infection Rates, Deaths, Treatment Access
topNews.excerpt: New HIV infections and AIDS-related deaths are at their lowest levels in more than 30 years, a special report released by UNAIDS shows.
